raw_model_deviations.claim_in_article: Meta had run a test that caused exactly this surprise.
raw_model_deviations.issue: The article states that the test caused a real surprise in which someone discovered a person was behind an apparently AI call. The Ledger confirms that trained contract workers handled some calls, but does not report that this surprise occurred.
raw_model_deviations.explanation: The phrase “caused exactly this surprise” adds an unverified event and causal link; it goes beyond the Ledger’s account that workers handled some calls.
raw_model_deviations.qualifier_text: A call seemed to come from an AI agent.
same_fact_id_locations: # We Thought It Was AI—But There Was a Person Inside Meta’s Muse
A call seemed to come from an AI agent. But as the conversation went on, the voice was not AI at all. It was a person.
